# Owned paired tokens and raw result context fixture

Distinct Class<K>/Class<V> inputs bind an invariant Map<K,V> result beside an
independent Class-extends-raw-Map context and Object value. The default overload
retains its original instanceof/getClass or HashMap token selection. Source and
SDK profiles compile every unit and retain entries, metadata and Exceptions.
Frozen callers run 144 fresh JVM cases twice through four routes. They observe
exact type/value/result identities, null tokens, aliases, dynamic context
selection, opaque maps, callback mutations and exact late get/cast failures.
Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving controls guard scopes and bounds.
Only owned fixture code executes. Use JDK 25 for verification; originals use
release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
